company-underwriting.operatingTrajectory: Fiscal Q3 sales $2.313B, +8% reported/+10% organic; Software & Control +19%; organic ARR +6%; quarterly FCF $654M vs $489M prior year.
company-underwriting.balanceSheet: Cash $479M at June 30 2026; commercial paper $684M, up from $522M at fiscal year-end, requiring monitoring but not evidencing distress.
company-underwriting.customersContracts: Demand cited across semiconductor, data center, warehouse automation, automotive and life sciences; customer concentration/backlog conversion not isolated in reviewed sources and is treated as non-gating uncertainty.
company-underwriting.governance: 2026 proxy states pay-for-performance and shareholder-value alignment framework; no current abuse defect evidenced in reviewed lineage.
company-underwriting.pricingPower: Input costs exceeded price realization in part of Q3, limiting evidence for strong current pricing power.
company-underwriting.catalysts: Raised FY2026 sales and adjusted EPS guidance; continued semiconductor/data-center/warehouse automation strength.

thesisQuality.basis: Strong installed industrial-control position plus broad current automation demand supports durable adoption, while cyclical capex and cyber risk prevent exceptional calibration.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Q3 sales and organic growth accelerated, FCF rose to $654M and guidance increased; commercial-paper growth tempers the upper band.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: At 2026-09-21 market data ROK carried about $47.18B market cap, 39.78x trailing P/E, 29.24x forward P/E and 28.35x EV/EBITDA, a demanding valuation relative to current growth despite improving fundamentals.

catalystScore.basis: Raised FY2026 sales/EPS guidance and identifiable semiconductor, data-center and warehouse automation strength provide credible near-term catalysts, but timing remains industrial-cycle dependent.

governancePower.basis: Proxy describes pay-for-performance/shareholder alignment and no material governance defect is evidenced; reviewed lineage does not support exceptional stewardship calibration.

alignment2036.basis: Industrial automation/control software supports productivity, labor substitution, semiconductor/data-center buildout and critical infrastructure across multiple long-duration needs.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Demand spans semiconductor, data center, warehouse, automotive and life sciences while software/control and lifecycle offerings reuse the automation platform; Lifecycle Services weakness prevents exceptional calibration.

bottleneckControl.basis: Installed OT/control infrastructure creates meaningful switching friction and mission-critical integration value, but evidence does not establish exclusive system bottleneck control.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Multiple industrial end markets and software/control exposure diversify demand, while industrial capex cyclicality and cybersecurity dependencies remain material.

substitutionResilience.basis: Installed control infrastructure and integration requirements create replacement friction, but open/competing architectures and cyber-driven replacement pressure remain credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Current execution and cash generation show adequate operating resilience, but reviewed sources do not establish tested multi-source redundancy sufficient for a strong 80-band score.

pricingPower.basis: Growth and margin execution show some value capture, but management disclosed input costs exceeding price realization, keeping pricing power in the mixed band.

riskEvidence.basis: Risk is moderate: cyclical industrial spending, OT cyber exposure, negative price/cost, Lifecycle Services weakness and higher commercial paper are material but current growth/FCF do not indicate acute impairment.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Recent SEC and issuer primary evidence covers operations, liquidity, catalysts and risks with independent current valuation; customer concentration and detailed supply-chain redundancy remain undisclosed in reviewed lineage.

scoreRecord.thesis: Rockwell is a high-quality industrial automation/control platform positioned for long-duration productivity and digital-factory demand, with current operating momentum strong but valuation, cyclicality and cyber/price-cost risks limiting asymmetry.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: A slowdown in industrial automation capex or architecture/share loss combined with premium valuation could compress both earnings expectations and multiple.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Fiscal Q4/FY2026 results and evidence that raised guidance converts into durable organic growth and cash flow.

scoreBreakdown.note: earthScore is the methodology-weighted component score; risk and dataConfidence are separately source-addressed inputs preserved for runtime gate/penalty treatment.
